LIFE UNDERGROUND

A signal of our own.

Hollow Signal connects early warnings, equitable resource planning, and offline family check-ins in one community tool.

All environmental readings are fictional. Warning thresholds and allocations are transparent demonstration rules, not validated forecasts or safety guidance. Water scores cannot establish potability.

Data is stored in this browser, without encryption. Relay packets move manually between devices; there is no radio mesh, live sensor feed, or emergency dispatch service.
